g.title: communication03
g.text: Communication 03: candidate turn ends -> streamed follow-up questions (Interviewer mode)

g.title: assist
g.text: start_followups, then the spawned run_followups task

g.title: note
g.text: A TranscriptionEvent::SpeechStarted from the candidate increments turn.version, so an older
timer finds a version mismatch and does nothing (2.1 guard). When the candidate's speech
ends with no text (Empty / Error / discarded), reschedule_turn re-arms the timer.
3.x run in the run_followups tokio task; * = repeated per streamed delta / parsed item.
Duplicates of asked questions and earlier suggestions are dropped; at most 4 are accepted.
